- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/queue` — An issuer's or verifier's queue: whether it has one, and how to read it
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/queue` — Make its queue and the user that reads it (admins); the password, once
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/queue` — Delete its queue, with what is in it, and its user (admins)
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/{kind}/{item_id}/queue/access` — Give its queue's user a new password (admins); the old one stops working
